primary.version: Original ARK: Survival Evolved with DLC/mod/server state documented
primary.why: The original PC release remains the archive route for Survival Evolved, but official servers were sunset in 2023 and ARK: Survival Ascended is a separate Unreal Engine 5 remake branch. Current preservation depends on single-player, non-dedicated, unofficial, or self-hosted servers plus exact DLC/mod state.
primary.how_to_play: Use the PC version with the intended map/DLC installed. Record build, DLC, mods, save/server type, official-server shutdown state, rates, difficulty, map, tribe/player settings, and whether Survival Ascended was compared separately.

secondary.exclusive_content: Unreal Engine 5 remake branch with its own content schedule
secondary.what_to_play: Document separately if covering the remake/current official ecosystem.
secondary.why: It does not replace the original Survival Evolved route for this entry.
PC is the best preservation and mod/server route.
